#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 10000;
const int MAXM = 2000000;
const int INF = 1e9;

int n, m, k, c, d;

struct Edge {
    int to, rev, cap, cost;
};

vector<vector<Edge>> g;
int N;

void init(int n) {
    N = n;
    g.assign(n, vector<Edge>());
}

void addedge(int u, int v, int cap, int cost) {
    g[u].push_back({v, (int)g[v].size(), cap, cost});
    g[v].push_back({u, (int)g[u].size() - 1, 0, -cost});
}

bool bellman_ford(int s, int t, vector<int>& pre, vector<int>& pre_edge) {
    vector<int> dist(N, INF);
    vector<bool> inq(N, false);
    queue<int> q;
    dist[s] = 0;
    q.push(s);
    inq[s] = true;
    while (!q.empty()) {
        int u = q.front(); q.pop();
        inq[u] = false;
        for (int i = 0; i < (int)g[u].size(); ++i) {
            Edge& e = g[u][i];
            if (e.cap > 0 && dist[e.to] > dist[u] + e.cost) {
                dist[e.to] = dist[u] + e.cost;
                pre[e.to] = u;
                pre_edge[e.to] = i;
                if (!inq[e.to]) {
                    inq[e.to] = true;
                    q.push(e.to);
                }
            }
        }
    }
    return dist[t] != INF;
}

int minCostMaxflow(int s, int t, int& cost) {
    int flow = 0;
    cost = 0;
    vector<int> pre(N), pre_edge(N);
    while (bellman_ford(s, t, pre, pre_edge)) {
        int add = INF;
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = pre[v]) {
            int u = pre[v];
            int ei = pre_edge[v];
            add = min(add, g[u][ei].cap);
        }
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = pre[v]) {
            int u = pre[v];
            int ei = pre_edge[v];
            g[u][ei].cap -= add;
            g[v][g[u][ei].rev].cap += add;
            cost += add * g[u][ei].cost;
        }
        flow += add;
    }
    return flow;
}

    cin >> n >> m >> k >> c >> d;
    init(MAXN);
    for (int i = 0; i < k; ++i) {
        int x;
        cin >> x;
        addedge(0, x, 1, 0);
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < 100; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < k; ++j) {
            addedge(1 + i * n, 9999, 1, i * c);
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {
        int u, v;
